product_context.name: Game Stream Highlight Detector
product_context.description: A tool to identify, score, and export high-impact moments from game streams.
key_features: Automated scoring and sorting of events
Filters for streamers, games, categories, and scores
Manual tagging and editing of highlights

design_principles: Clarity: Ensure the interface is intuitive and easy to navigate
Efficiency: Minimize the number of steps required to achieve key tasks
Customization: Allow users to tailor scoring criteria and sorting options

test_strategy.description: Evaluate the intuitiveness and ease of use of the GUI with target users.
Validate the accuracy of the AI model in detecting high-impact moments.
methods: Compare detected highlights with manually curated data

test_strategy.description: Ensure the app performs efficiently with large datasets.
methods: Stress testing with large sample data
Measure response times for scoring and filtering

test_strategy.description: Verify the export functionality works as expected.
methods: Test exported files on multiple platforms
Validate data integrity in exported files

acceptance_criteria: Generated project must run locally from index.html under python -m http.server.
Provide a real JSON import path using FileReader and/or a textarea; imported data must be processed by the app.
Implement a real scoring function and sort detected items by score descending in executable JavaScript.
Provide visible filter controls and executable filter logic for the requested fields.
Provide a manual marker form/control that appends a new item to the working dataset and rerenders results.
Provide a real export action using Blob, URL.createObjectURL, an anchor download, and the current filtered result set.
Persist working data locally with localStorage and reload it on page load.
Use domain fields such as streamer, game, timestamp/time, category, intensity, chatRate, keywords, title, description, and score.
